reviews.text: Awesome game by an even more awesome team. Very happy to play the full version. Congrats on the release!

Roulette Dungeon is a fantastic and addicting game! It doesn't take long to understand how the game is played and you are immeadiately hooked! I especially love the attention to detail and creativeness in how to make the game so more enjoyable. Every run is different and after you get defeated the urge to try again is huge!
Amazing work from the devs. Lovely art style, fun humour and pure gambling addiction! I love the character Marigold! Really cool mechanics <3
Can fully recommend if you like to gamble in prison. Not that i have experience in that.
This game is very fun and very cute, the artstyle is great imo. There’s also loads to unlock in terms of characters, skins, items, pocket mods, and achievements!

Looks rather simple at first but has a surprising level of depth. My 90 minutes playtime were the tutorial and one run (win). It also took a couple of upgrades to get the hang of some basic features, most prominently the bets. Tutorialization can benefit from some more polishing. Also some UI elements need to be repositioned, like the slicing minigame start and slice buttons are in different positions -> confusing Lastly, it's unfortunate that the game doesn't have a proper gamepad mapping yet. It was quite irksome to play on the Steam Deck.

Love the uniqe gameplay of rougelikes and gambling. Brings out that randomness that all games have to its fullest potential. The references in this game are elite ball knowledge. Well worth the $8 I spent on this game. Also Platypus Snugglebutt is the best skin

OMG! The amount of content is unbelievable, and the core loop is super addicting! Also the art on this game is on another level!!! As an artist myself I feel super inspired by it. Perfect look and feel! Amazing job by the devs, BUY. THIS. GAME. You won't regret it...
Very fun game! I greatly enjoy the music <3
absolutely love this game so far, have over 50k hp on endless mode. pls nerf the green powder.

I was reluctant to buy due to a low review count, but it actually seems to be a pretty fun game. While some game design choices can be questionable (the need for 3 different roulette settings rather than 1 incorporating all based on a build), overall I do recommend it, especially for a discounted price.

Well so far I lost after about 10 rounds, and right after that my second run I spun literally five 0's in a row and lost against my first opponent, much harder then the demo but I'll give it a few more chances. I didn't get anything to help me on my next runs.... Edit: Third game and couldn't get past the 4th guy, there literally wasn't anything I could have even gotten to help. I get it's all up to chance but this is just not fun right now, which is super disappointing since I liked the demo enough to pay for it. I need to take a break but if I play again and this keeps happening I'm refund the game. I'm done, i played 3 more games and lost my first one to the FIRST guy, literally nothing I could do, ran out of money and kept landing on 0. Pretty much the same results on the second two (did make it to the 5th guy one time), and cannot progress enough to earn anything for my next game. Maybe if you just keep playing and collecting the reward every 10 minutes it will get easier, but I'm not grinding for 3 hours to be able to progress.
tons of fun!
A nice and funny roguelike game, i really enjoyed it so far.

At this point (version 1.0.4) game has a lack of events. If don't pay attention to it, great roguelike about gambling and more gambling, hope devs won't abandon their project and keep up with regular updates

It's like a cross between Dungeon clawler & Slay the spire. It's a good little fun game and should just become better with time. It really needs controller support though, living room gaming with keyboard and mouse is not ideal.
Swiss Indie Game. Developed by Hooded Traveler Games based in Baden.
RNG heavy so perfect for those who like the thrill of gambling. Even though it requires more luck than planning it is still a very successful balatrofication.
[demo] Highly addictive with fun roulette play and familiar charm. Hard to stop once you start, even at 2 am. Just. One. More. Spin.

[Speculative] A roguelike dungeon crawler where you—a gambling addict cat—engage in turn/roulette-based combat to 'break out of prison'. Contains choices, minigames and many stat-altering items/perks.
